P:What is an exact positive cross-modal pair?
M:The text and numeric observations refer to the same exact instance.
Q:TEXT A -> NUMERIC A
V:validated
A:Both modalities refer to the same instance.

P:What is a hard negative?
M:It is an incorrect instance that has a high similarity to the query.
Q:HIGH SIMILARITY + WRONG INSTANCE
V:validated
A:A similar but incorrect instance.
